_comment: VS-3 subject registry — the exemplar embeddings that recognise this owner's recurring subjects. Keyed by the SAME subject_id as photo-entities.json people/pets, so subjects and entities are one model: the JSON twin holds the facts, this file holds the vectors. Ships empty and stays empty until a vision-confirmed pick is memorized (V2-6 blank sheet). Shape and rules: docs/photo-memory-pack.md.
_defaults_comment: Pack-supplied STARTING values, not calibrated ones. accept/gray_low are the Visual-Sorting DESIGN's numbers pending a benchmark replay; the tolerance and the cap are the engine's own starting values. Edit them here rather than in the engine — the engine holds no owner thresholds.
